verification_kind: real VideoPlayer integration plus presentation-helper checks; physical UI button clicks were not tested

steps.name: initial_decoded_frame_paused
steps.evidence: Requires a real frameReady event, a decoded texture, actual first frame, and matching data window.

steps.name: play_1x
steps.evidence: Measured advancement from real VideoPlayer.time over elapsed wall time.

steps.name: pause_holds_decoded_frame
steps.evidence: After allowing a pending decode to settle, actual time and frame must remain fixed.

steps.name: play_2x
steps.evidence: Requires actual decoded time to advance at 1.4–2.6 seconds per elapsed second; setting the property alone is insufficient.

steps.name: seek_20.2
steps.evidence: The controller must receive seekCompleted and a real target frameReady; the shown window must match the Unity-reported video timestamp.

steps.name: seek_930.2
steps.evidence: The controller must receive seekCompleted and a real target frameReady; the shown window must match the Unity-reported video timestamp.

steps.name: seek_1800.2
steps.evidence: The controller must receive seekCompleted and a real target frameReady; the shown window must match the Unity-reported video timestamp.

steps.name: seek_3599.5
steps.evidence: The controller must receive seekCompleted and a real target frameReady; the shown window must match the Unity-reported video timestamp.

steps.name: seek_end_segment
steps.evidence: End-segment navigation requires completed seek, a real decoded frame, <=0.1s reported-time error and the expected data window. Exact last-source-frame identity is not claimed; the strict timestamp comparison is recorded separately.

steps.name: natural_eof
steps.evidence: Requires the actual loopPointReached callback within 5 seconds, decoded frames, automatic pause and window 359 selected from Unity-reported time. Review the captured source header separately for exact final-frame identity.

steps.name: restore_first_frame_paused
steps.evidence: Restore actual first frame and normal playback speed.

diagnostics.name: source_last_pts_vs_unity_navigation_time
diagnostics.interpretation: Timing observation only, not a product pass/fail. Unity time/frame can be quantized navigation values. Inspect the burned-in source header to establish frame identity. End seeks do not claim the exact last source frame.

ui_feature_checks.name: region_selection_opens_details
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Call the same SelectRegion helper as the interface. A valid selection opens its details; an invalid index must not replace the selection.

ui_feature_checks.name: unavailable_motion_is_not_a_zero_sample
ui_feature_checks.evidence: The first-window Junction center has unavailable motion. The actual plotting helper must return false, so its out value is not a plotted zero or a speed.

ui_feature_checks.name: first_window_high_count_is_not_sustained
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Use the actual count-series and persistence-explanation helpers: Upper road is high count in window 0, but 10 seconds is below 30 seconds. State must remain No sustained signal. Explanation: High count duration: 10 s   ·   Required: 30 s

ui_feature_checks.name: existing_example_targets_stay_in_their_windows
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Validate the nine existing demonstration milestones as navigation examples, not newly detected traffic events. Each actual helper target must stay in its milestone's source window.

ui_feature_checks.name: example_1_seeks_real_video
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Call OpenExample, then require a newly decoded real frame, completed seek, correct reported-time window and intended region. This does not simulate a mouse click.

ui_feature_checks.name: example_8_seeks_real_video
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Call OpenExample, then require a newly decoded real frame, completed seek, correct reported-time window and intended region. This does not simulate a mouse click.

ui_feature_checks.name: feature_checks_restore_first_frame_overview
ui_feature_checks.evidence: After helper-driven navigation, restore the real first frame paused in the overview.

ui_feature_checks.name: input_json_unchanged
ui_feature_checks.evidence: Compare the exact StreamingAssets JSON bytes before and after all engine/helper checks. No data or thresholds may be rewritten.
